name: Parallel Reminiscent: Earth
source:
[i]Emotional pain is a tricky thing to overcome, but perhaps in this new world, you'll realize that you don't have to go through it alone.[/i]

It was a normal autumn morning when Prince Kairo, a wolf beastman, was minding his own business when suddenly, he found himself traversing a pathway through another world and ended up on Earth. Born in a medieval world with sword and magic, he now tries to find a way back home while needing to adapt to the world of advance technology and full of humans.

Nevertheless, he’s not alone in this journey, with companions new and old they’ll face past buried feelings and know how grief can change an individual. For sometimes underneath a smile, holds a person’s devastating pain.

[From [url=https://iceflakevn.itch.io/parallel-reminiscent-earth]Itch.io[/url]]
